saw_lines: Handbag buyers check size, strap and laptop fit before they click, then come back for the same style in new colors.
So the sale is decided in line one, where buyers ask if the bag fits, and your ads never answer it.
Your site offers 10% off your first purchase, yet 0 of 9 ads mention it. Put that offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: Your site offers 10% off the first purchase, yet 0 of 9 ads mention it. A new buyer has no reason to act today. Put that 10% first purchase offer in line one of three new ads, and on the creative.

Your site lists free shipping above 200 EUR, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping. Buyers check delivery before they click, and silence loses to the next brand. Answer it first in three new ads, with free shipping above 200 EUR.

None of your 30 ads carries a proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust but the photo. Buyers want a count, like reviews or orders shipped. Pick one figure you can stand behind and open three ads with it.
21 of your 30 live ads are catalog feed ads with no story behind them. Only 9 ads carry written copy about the bag. Add three story ads showing it on a commute or weekend trip.

ads_1: Offer first creative for handbags, tested against a shipping answer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram, your two linked channels
